questions.prompt: Who experiences the problem, in what situation, what happens today, and why does it matter now?
questions.evidence: Reviewed Discover handoff, research, defects, learnings, and current behavior
questions.purpose: Define the user problem and urgency without jumping to a solution.
questions.completion_evidence: Names an affected user, current situation or behavior, impact, and why action matters.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the affected user, what happens today, its impact, or why solving it matters now.

questions.prompt: Who needs this outcome, what should they be able to accomplish, and what existing behavior must remain unchanged? If every user behaves the same, say so.
questions.evidence: Discover personas, existing roles and permissions, and current journeys
questions.purpose: Capture the audience, desired outcome, and non-regression boundary in one decision when the feature is simple.
questions.completion_evidence: Identifies the affected user, desired outcome, whether access differs, and what existing value must remain true.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please identify who needs the outcome, what they should accomplish, and what existing behavior must remain unchanged.

questions.prompt: What user and business outcomes should change, and which guardrails must not regress?
questions.evidence: Discover outcomes, product vision, baselines, analytics, and policy
questions.purpose: Separate desired outcomes from implementation and protect existing value.
questions.completion_evidence: States a user or business outcome plus at least one non-regression guardrail.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the desired outcome and a guardrail that must not regress.

questions.prompt: Walk me through the essential journey from entry to completion. Include the observable result on the happy path and for any material failure or recovery path; this answer will become the first acceptance criteria.
questions.evidence: Current product behavior, related requirements, defects, and support evidence
questions.purpose: Cover the complete journey rather than only its happy path.
questions.completion_evidence: Describes entry, completion, and the observable result for each material success, failure, or recovery path.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the journey entry and completion plus the material failure, cancellation, or recovery path.

questions.prompt: What must the product do, and what observable Given/When/Then behavior proves each stable requirement?
questions.evidence: Confirmed flows, business rules, policies, and existing contracts
questions.purpose: Turn product obligations into stable, observable requirements.
questions.completion_evidence: Provides product behavior and independently observable proof, preferably Given/When/Then.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add observable proof for the requirement, including the triggering condition and expected result.

questions.prompt: How will success be measured, what threshold or baseline is required, where does the measurement come from, and who owns it?
questions.evidence: Existing instrumentation, historical baselines, and desired outcomes
questions.purpose: Make success measurable and operationally owned.
questions.completion_evidence: Names a metric, threshold or baseline plan, measurement source, and owner.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the metric, threshold or baseline plan, measurement source, and responsible owner.

questions.prompt: What is in scope, explicitly out of scope, dependent on other work, or constrained by sequencing? Include any material release risk or open decision and its owner; say none if there is not one.
questions.evidence: Related features, organizational constraints, and release dependencies
questions.purpose: Set an implementable boundary and capture delivery dependencies or risks without forcing another question for a simple feature.
questions.completion_evidence: States inclusions, exclusions, relevant dependencies, and any material release risk or open decision with an owner.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add explicit inclusions, exclusions, dependencies, and any material release risk or open decision with an owner.

questions.prompt: Which authorization, privacy, compliance, abuse, rollout, assumption, risk, or unresolved decision needs explicit ownership?
questions.evidence: Security policy, regulatory requirements, historical failures, and existing decisions
questions.purpose: Surface controls, risks, and unresolved decisions before approval.
questions.completion_evidence: Names applicable controls, risks, assumptions, or open decisions and assigns ownership where material.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please identify the material control, risk, assumption, or open decision and who owns it.
